caption: The Ladder, Saba
composition: Concrete steps down a cliff toward a dark bay · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Ladder is the steep stair of concrete and rock from the 1930s, down the cliff to Ladder Bay, with a small customs house above the steps. The lowest steps were damaged in 2017 and are not rebuilt. It is overcast, about 27.5°C, with wind near 22.5 km/h and cloud cover about 87%. The scenario uses America/Kralendijk. No ferry is alongside.
